screen1-a1.glyph: two horizontal lines, the lower one shorter
screen1-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Menu" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a1.convention_relied_on: two/three stacked lines = open the main menu (hamburger) - my reading; the two-line variant is slightly less canonical than three lines
screen1-a1.initial_rationale: no label, but two stacked horizontal lines is a recognizable variant of the hamburger menu convention - common-icon exemption pending the behavioural test

test_cases.precondition: app open on a new chat
test_cases.action: tap the two-line glyph at top left and watch
test_cases.expected_result: a menu or navigation panel opens
test_cases.confirms_if: it does something other than open a menu
test_cases.observed_result: a navigation drawer slid in from the left listing Images, Library, Projects, Scheduled, Plugins and past chats; the taps registered about 3-5 s late

screen1-a1.deciding_evidence: tapping it slid a navigation drawer in from the left, exactly what the menu convention promises; the missing label is not a barrier

screen1-a2.description: pill in the header with a sparkle glyph and the words 'Get Plus'
screen1-a2.location: pill in the header with a sparkle glyph and the words 'Get Plus'
screen1-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Get Plus" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a2.initial_rationale: visible words 'Get Plus' with a sparkle; 'Plus' is a product name a first-time user has no way to decode, and nothing says it costs money

test_cases.expected_result: the label predicts getting something called Plus
test_cases.confirms_if: the outcome is a paid subscription the words did not predict
test_cases.overturns_if: the outcome is plainly what a first-time user would expect from the words
test_cases.observed_result: opened a full-screen 'ChatGPT Plus' page with a Free/Plus feature table and a black 'Upgrade for $19.99' button, 'Renews monthly. Cancel anytime.'

screen1-a2.deciding_evidence: tapping opened a paywall ('ChatGPT Plus', 'Upgrade for $19.99', 'Renews monthly') - a paid monthly subscription the words 'Get Plus' never mentioned
screen1-a2.recommendation: say what it is and that it is paid, e.g. 'Upgrade to Plus (paid plan)'

screen1-a3.glyph: speech bubble drawn with a broken outline
screen1-a3.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Temporary chat" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a3.initial_rationale: a speech bubble drawn with a broken outline is not an established convention and carries no label

test_cases.action: long-press the glyph for 1.2 s looking for a tooltip, then observe
test_cases.confirms_if: no label appears in any state before the tap
test_cases.overturns_if: a tooltip or visible caption names the control
test_cases.observed_result: no tooltip appeared; the long-press acted as a tap and switched the screen to a 'Temporary chat' view ('This chat won't appear in history.') with the glyph now showing a checkmark - the name appears only after activation

screen1-a3.deciding_evidence: no tooltip on long-press and no visible text in any state before activation; the words 'Temporary chat' appear only on the screen the tap opens
screen1-a3.recommendation: add a visible label beside or under the glyph, e.g. 'Temporary chat (not saved)'

screen1-a4.description: suggestion row: outline glyph at left followed by the words
screen1-a4.location: suggestion row: outline glyph at left followed by the words
screen1-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Start a voice chat" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a4.initial_rationale: row reads 'Start a voice chat' with a headphones glyph - the words say what happens

test_cases.observed_result: not run: starting voice mode is not allowed; the row is also absent from the current live build

screen1-a4.deciding_evidence: the visible words 'Start a voice chat' state the action; not exercised because starting voice mode is outside the safety rules, and the row no longer appears on the live build

screen1-a5.description: suggestion row: outline glyph at left followed by the words
screen1-a5.location: suggestion row: outline glyph at left followed by the words
screen1-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Create an image or sticker" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a5.initial_rationale: row reads 'Create an image or sticker' with a picture glyph

test_cases.expected_result: an image-creation mode or screen opens
test_cases.observed_result: the composer showed a blue 'Create image' token and a Trending/Templates grid of captioned image tiles appeared

screen1-a5.deciding_evidence: tapping switched the screen into image creation: a 'Create image' token in the composer and a grid of style tiles - what the words promise

screen1-a6.description: suggestion row: outline glyph at left followed by the words
screen1-a6.location: suggestion row: outline glyph at left followed by the words
screen1-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Write or edit" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a6.initial_rationale: row reads 'Write or edit' with a pencil glyph

test_cases.observed_result: a panel headed 'Write or edit' with three pencil-glyph suggestions appeared and the composer placeholder changed to 'Write anything'

screen1-a6.deciding_evidence: tapping opened a 'Write or edit' panel of writing suggestions above the composer - consistent with the words

screen1-a7.description: left end of the message composer
screen1-a7.location: left end of the message composer
screen1-a7.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Attachment" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a7.convention_relied_on: plus sign = add / attach - my reading
screen1-a7.initial_rationale: unlabeled plus sign; + = add something is an established convention - exemption pending test

test_cases.expected_result: a menu of things to add opens
test_cases.confirms_if: it does something other than add
test_cases.observed_result: a pop-up card opened with Camera, Photos, Files, Plugins and Think harder

screen1-a7.deciding_evidence: tapping opened an add menu (Camera, Photos, Files, Plugins, Think harder) - adding things to the message, as the plus convention promises

screen1-a8.accessibility_text_consulted: no strings on the record; not used in the verdict
screen1-a8.initial_rationale: placeholder 'Ask ChatGPT' in the bottom text box names what to put in: a question for ChatGPT
screen1-a8.deciding_evidence: the placeholder names the expected content, and a chat composer's own text is self-describing once typing starts; not a finding

screen1-a9.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Dictation" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a9.convention_relied_on: microphone = speak instead of typing - my reading
screen1-a9.initial_rationale: unlabeled microphone; microphone = speak / voice input is an established convention - exemption pending test

test_cases.expected_result: voice input starts or microphone access is requested
test_cases.confirms_if: it does something unrelated to speaking
test_cases.overturns_if: it starts listening or asks for the microphone
test_cases.observed_result: Android's 'Allow ChatGPT to record audio?' dialog appeared; I chose 'Don't allow' and returned to the chat

screen1-a9.deciding_evidence: tapping raised the system request to record audio - the microphone convention held (permission was denied per safety rules)

screen1-a10.glyph: blue filled circle with vertical sound-wave bars
screen1-a10.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Start a voice conversation" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen1-a10.initial_rationale: a filled circle with vertical sound-wave bars is not an established convention a first-time user would read, and it carries no label

test_cases.action: tap the blue sound-wave circle and observe; check for any label before and after
test_cases.confirms_if: no label exists before the tap
test_cases.observed_result: the whole screen changed to a grey voice layout, then Android's record-audio request appeared; after denying, a dialog read 'Please enable microphone access in System Settings to use Voice.' - the word Voice appears only after activation

screen1-a10.deciding_evidence: no label in any state before the tap; only after tapping does a dialog mention 'Voice', and the control sits right beside a microphone, so the two voice controls are not told apart
screen1-a10.recommendation: label it, e.g. 'Talk with ChatGPT' beside the glyph, and distinguish it from the dictation microphone
